## Design

### 2026-10-31: October 30: #P0LAR15!!!

**3.5h**

October 30: #P0LAR15!!!

First day on working on it, I was surprised to see that the directions were quite vague and short, but I got over it, go check out READ.ME for most of my progress!!!

One mistake during this project was that I assigned the wrong footprints to C1, C2, R1, R2, the capacitors and resistors, they ended up being super huge!

![Screenshot 2026-10-30 211829](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/7808de006a85a94407c759c2d7bce2b7d90adb860a2470f7a9aefcb589d76fa5.png)

Another mistake was that I put VCC for output 36 on the Pico, but since the OLED connector is +3V3, I had to switch VCC for +3V3:

![Screenshot 2026-10-27 161335](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/04975696360b88a513404b04b7ed1c9c0f72a36a713f7f715949a3ca766a1ba0.png)

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/UMx8GtS67VH17jO55ZdjXA5Q5GgA51Ts/9e1c6f7c0240ba4bb7100324970299d69c9a11f12ca026ea2e02bb8d76170f67.png)
